$comment: The ONE product-repo registry. Every repo here has a guards/<repo>.paths expertise list and vice versa — schema-validate enforces both directions. `routable: true` means ticket-intake may route work here from a repo:<name> label; widening that is a human decision because it widens what the coding agent can write to. `routable: false` repos are known to the pipeline (guard self-tests, ledger, digests) but never receive routed tickets.

example-app-core.note: Ticket repo for every team ticket; implementation for core-scoped claude-led tickets

example-app-service.note: Guarded (auth + billing) but not yet in the pilot; no routed tickets

agent-ops.note: This repo. Judged only for loop verification (planted-defect PR); never a ticket target
